simple.meaning: לֻלָאָה (lulâʼâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a loop.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 26:4. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to לֻלָאָה (H3924) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

definitions.full: H3924. lulaah [ לוּלַי ] noun feminine loop (probably from לולו ; compare [ דוּדַי ] p. 188 above; Zehnpf BAS i. 635 , compare Assyrian lu-lu, 'Schleife' ); — only plural absolute לָֻלָאֹת Exod 26:5 (3 t. in verse) + 8 t., construct לֻלְאֹת 26:4 ; 36:11 ; — loops on edges of curtains of tabernacle, matching the hooks (קְרָסִיםׅ , for joining the ourtains: 26:4-5 , (3 t. in verse); 26:10 (twice in verse); 26:11 ; 36:11-12 , (3 t. in verse); 36:17 (twice in verse) (all P). לוּלֵי see לוּלֵא below לוּ .
